material_type.evidence: inferred: Cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is in direct contact with the brain and serves as a valuable specimen to examine diseases of the central nervous system through analyzing its components.

sample_source.evidence: For this, four spectral libraries were generated with samples from native CSF ( n = 5), CSF fractionation (15 in total) and substantia nigra fractionation (54 in total) and applied to three CSF DIA replicates.

tissue.evidence: inferred: over 60 brain-originated proteins could be identified compared to only 11 with DDA.
